resources.string: Cleaning text backgrounds — recognized text is ready
Saved reader for Camera and Screen & manga: %1$s
Compact uses a small text detector. Koharu adds pixel masks and panel order; cleanup removes the original lettering. Each choice uses its own required model files.

Koharu RF-DETR segmentation, panel and bubble grouping, and Manga OCR. Captured Japanese pages · CPU · Experimental · High runtime memory use. Detector weights have Manga109 academic-data terms; read the model card.

Koharu page segmentation and Manga OCR with LaMa cleanup of the original lettering. Captured Japanese pages · CPU · Experimental · Highest memory and processing cost. Detector weights have Manga109 academic-data terms.
This reader needs model files. Open Reader to download or import them before starting.
Manga readers work on a captured, settled page. Scrolling interrupts the current page; keep it still while reading and translating.
